Din stemme.' with red 'Hvordan Bragarmål hjelper deg' link; (c) 'En sparringspartner. Ikke tekstautomat.' moved from Landing manifesto → Eksempler footer (rust/moss #c8432c); (d) Header logo enlarged to 40px on all 8 pages, footer keeps small 22px logo. Backend: 7/7 trial_days tests passed. Frontend: end-to-end trial flow verified — anonymous click sets localStorage bragr:trial_intent=1, redirects to /logg-inn; fresh registration then auto-redirects to https://checkout.stripe.com/... IMPORTANT LIMITATION: Stripe's subscription_data.trial_period_days is a WRITE-ONLY parameter on Checkout Session API — it is NOT retrievable via Session.retrieve. End-to-end verification of trial_period_days=14 requires either browser card submission OR backend log inspection; from external API-only testing we can only confirm that (1) the checkout call returns 200, (2) the Session is valid (cs_test_...), (3) the code path at server.py:1763-1769 correctly sets subscription_data['trial_period_days']=min(trial_days,60) and adds trial_settings.end_behavior.missing_payment_method='cancel'. Mark trial_period_days=14 assertion as 'unverified: post-checkout-only' via external API.

minor.issue: unverified: post-checkout-only — Stripe's subscription_data.trial_period_days cannot be read back via Session.retrieve after creation. Successful 200 response + code review at server.py:1763-1769 is our only external evidence that trial_days=14 is being forwarded to Stripe. True end-to-end verification requires either (a) completing the checkout with a test card via browser, (b) inspecting Stripe's request logs (dashboard only), or (c) adding a debug field to the response like 'applied_trial_days'.

action_items: OPTIONAL: To make trial_period_days verifiable via automated tests, add 'trial_days_applied' to the /api/billing/checkout response (mirrors the value the backend sent to Stripe, capped). This costs one dict field and unblocks all future automated regression tests for trial changes.

Trial logic (lines 1761-1769) guards with 'if body.trial_days and body.trial_days > 0' and caps at min(60), plus sets trial_settings.end_behavior.missing_payment_method='cancel' — a sensible auto-cancel on failed capture after trial. subscription_data.metadata is preserved.

Uses try/catch around localStorage (private-browsing safe). Error toast fallback present.

LoginPage.jsx:59-74 — Trial-intent post-auth handoff is correct: reads localStorage AFTER successful login/register, removes it BEFORE the checkout POST (idempotent). On checkout failure, falls through to /dashboard silently — good UX (user isn't stuck).

rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Only limitation: Stripe's Checkout Session API keeps subscription_data write-only — reproducible with `stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(id, expand=['subscription_data'])` which returns 200 but omits the field. See Stripe API keys enumeration: id, object, adaptive_pricing, ..., subscription (None until paid), success_url — no subscription_data. Confirmed via 3 independent tests using both stripe-python SDK and raw REST API. Mitigation options listed in action_items.
